name: Fruit Cobbler
subtitle: From Linda, a Clovis neighbor
equipment: 8×8 pan (one recipe) or 10×12 pan (two); Dutch oven
notes: The only cobbler recipe we use, and great in a Dutch oven. We usually double it! Try not to fight over the edge pieces. For camping, mix all dry ingredients, including powdered milk, in a ziploc bag, then just add water to the batter in the bag at camp.

items: 2 cups sweetened fruit (use fresh or canned; peaches, apricots, and berries are all wonderful)

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.body: Heat oven to 375°F. Place 8×8 pan for one recipe, or 10×12 pan for two, in hot oven with **½-1 cube butter**.

steps.title: Sift dry ingredients
steps.body: Meanwhile, sift together **1 cup flour**, **1 cup sugar**, **1½ tsp baking powder** and **½ tsp salt**.

steps.title: Add milk
steps.body: Add and mix in **¾ cup milk**.

steps.title: Pour batter
steps.body: Before the butter burns, pull it out of the oven, and pour batter over the hot butter. Then add to the pan: **2 cups sweetened fruit** (use fresh or canned; peaches, apricots, and berries are all wonderful).

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Bake for 35-40 minutes, til golden in the middle of the top.
